mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile action: it brought the skin, nerves and muscles together in an everyday example of feedback.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the surface barrier to the supporting layer was fairly predictable, though the resulting cross-section clarified how living surface cells receive supplies.

surprise.text: I was interested that the outermost skin cells are dead while living layers beneath replace them.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave them clear purposes.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it connected the assembled systems to another everyday action. The glass example made their cooperation feel concrete, although the individual assembly steps were often predictable.
